title: Finite constructibility partitions and unchanged intervals for immersion restriction and closed direct image
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\geq1$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (locally Noetherian and quasi-compact) on which $\ell$ is invertible, let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion, and let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be its complementary open immersion [pqf-def-locnoeth], [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-weil-open-immersion]. Use constant $A_n$-module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites, finite constructibility as a finite disjoint locally closed constructible partition with locally constant finite-module restrictions, and the derived categories $D^b_c(-,A_n)$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility].

Ordinary inverse images $i^{-1},j^{-1}$ and closed direct image $i_*$ induce exact triangulated functors $i^*,j^*,Ri_*=i_*$ on these bounded constructible categories [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed]. For every integer interval $[a,b]$, each of these three functors preserves that same cohomological interval; more precisely $\mathcal H^r(FC)\cong F\mathcal H^r(C)$ for every $r$ and $F\in\{i^{-1},j^{-1},i_*\}$ [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves], [def-weil-cohomological-support].

For a constructible sheaf $M$ on $X$, a partition $(S_\nu)$ witnessing constructibility pulls back to the partitions $(S_\nu\times_XZ)$ and $(S_\nu\times_XU)$ witnessing constructibility of its two inverse images. For a constructible sheaf $N$ on $Z$ with partition $(T_\mu)$, the same locally closed subschemes $T_\mu\to Z\to X$, together with $U$, witness constructibility of $i_*N$: its restriction to $T_\mu$ is that of $N$ and its restriction to $U$ is zero. Empty strata may be omitted. No reducedness hypothesis on $Z$ is required.

proof.text: Use exact constant-ring pullback from def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations. The Noetherian open immersion is quasi-compact by Mathlib. Apply lem-sfb-proetale-identified-open-closed to the canonical constant-ring comparisons to obtain exact closed direct image and an invertible counit. The adjunction transpose identity identifies its scalar map with proEtaleCoefficientDirectImageMap, so this is the specified proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage. Apply the forward essential-image implication of lem-exc-proetale-closed-essential-image to obtain its zero open restriction.

For each original stratum, apply lem-sf-cartesian-stratum-module-restriction. Its final clause gives local constancy and finite geometric stalks on the actual pullback scheme. Convert the universe-general local-constancy predicate by unpacking its True model condition. Thus lemma-constructible-pullback-stratification is the required same-index partition, and witnesses sheaf constructibility.

Forget only the constructibility field of the supplied closed-side stratification and apply lem-sf-closed-partition-module-test with the counit and zero restriction from step 1. Its dependent-pair equalities yield isomorphisms of the original domain schemes over X by equality elimination. Reindex Fin(n+1) by Fin n plus Unit using finSumFinEquiv. The returned partition retains every composite immersion and adds precisely the supplied U; its stratum tests prove closed direct-image constructibility. Its index set is nonempty because it contains the open index, also when all schemes are empty.

Use the existing exact-functor termwise factorization, triangulated structure and source-library rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory to compare the specified functors with termwise exact descent. The source-library mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso gives the natural cohomology comparison in every integer degree. These are the established exact-functor constructions of lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization and lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-functor, not new assumptions.

For every complex C and degree r, zero source cohomology maps to zero under the additive ordinary functor; transport through the comparison of step 4. Contraposition gives support(DF C) subset support(C), so every identical interval is preserved, even for a>b. A subset of finite support is finite. Apply steps 2 and 3 to each source cohomology sheaf and transport its constructible witness through the same comparison. These are exactly both clauses of intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible.
